name: Yuan Ming Qing Tian Fei Gong Yi Zhi Bo Wu Guan
cn: 元明清天妃宫遗址博物馆
hours: 08:30–17:00 (last entry 16:00); closed Mondays at some museums — check ahead
hl: Yuan Ming Qing Tian Fei Gong Yi Zhi Bo Wu Guan（元明清天妃宫遗址博物馆）is a visitor attraction in Tianjin, Tianjin — set aside 2–3 hours for the main circuit.
Best season: Mar–May, Sep–Nov. Arrive within 30 minutes of opening to stay ahead of tour groups.
Expect around ¥60 for the main ticket; peak holidays may sell out — book ahead when caps apply.
how: Gateway: Tianjin, Tianjin. Reach the city by high-speed rail or flight, then local bus, taxi or DiDi to the gate (often 30–90 minutes). Use the Chinese name「元明清天妃宫遗址博物馆」in map/taxi apps — English signs are uneven.
tips: Carry your passport: many ticketed sites in Tianjin require real-name booking for foreign visitors.
Pay with Alipay or WeChat Pay (link an international card before you travel); cash is rarely useful.
Avoid the first three days of Golden Week (early Oct) and the Spring Festival rush if you want quieter paths.
hotel: Base in Tianjin: comfortable 3–4★ hotels typically ¥250–750/night within a taxi ride of the site; book early for weekends and holidays.
